diagnostics.message: `google_bigquery_table.views` creates SQL views whose query text (from var.views) commonly references the base tables created by `google_bigquery_table.default` in the same module. BigQuery validates the view's SQL against referenced tables at creation time, so if a view is created before the base table it queries exists, creation fails with a "not found" error. Currently both resources only depend on `google_bigquery_dataset.default` and are created in parallel. A bare depends_on is needed here because the query is supplied as a plain string variable, so no attribute reference can express the ordering.
